newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danisco sees profit growth slowing in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Danisco sees profit growth slowing in 1997/98.

text.p: Denmark's Danisco said on Wednesday that it expected 1997/98 profits to rise relative to 1996/97 but at a lower rate than the rise to 1.8 billion crowns in 1996/97 from 1.6 billion the year before.
"For the accounting year 1997/98 an improved group result is expected. The rise, however, is expected to be less than in 1996/97," Danisco said.
Net profit rose to 1.392 billion crowns in the year to April 30 1997, from 1.218 billion the year before, a 14 percent rise.
But although the results matched forecasts the stock market had still hoped for more and punished the share, pushing it down to 415.00 crowns from 423.00 before the results were published.
A dealer said that 415.00 probably represented the bottom of its fall. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
